name: ProteinNet: Standardized Dataset for Machine Learning of Protein Structure
description: ProteinNet is a standardized machine learning data set designed for protein structure prediction, sequence-to-structure modeling, and structural bioinformatics. Curated by Mohammed AlQuraishi, it integrates protein sequences, multiple sequence alignments (MSAs), position-specific scoring matrices (PSSMs), and experimental 3D atom coordinates from the Protein Data Bank (PDB), linked directly to the biennial CASP (Critical Assessment of Structure Prediction) blind assessments.
